_comment: Per deck-stage word targets for the 50-word expansion.
A target is a CEILING, not a quota. Where a stage is a closed or near-closed
set — the days of the week, the numbers under twenty, the prepositions — 50
cannot be reached without filler, and filler is worse than a smaller stage.
An agent that cannot fill its target returns fewer and says why; the stage is
then rounded down to the nearest 10.
Authoring metadata only. Never shipped: tools/ is in .assetsignore.

capped.tiempo: Basics is 7 days + 12 months + a handful — a closed set. 40.
capped.numeros: Basics is 0-20 plus a few ordinals. Numbers run out. 40.
capped.lugar: Basics is the prepositions of place, a closed class, and the rest are already in preguntas. 40.
capped.preguntas: Function words are a closed class throughout. Fluent locutions are the one plentiful stage.

new.name: Talking to People
new.scope: Greetings, farewells, introductions, courtesy, apology, thanks, agreement and disagreement, small talk, humour, gossip, invitations, phone and message openings. The social formulas a learner needs on day one. NOT grammar connectors — those are the preguntas deck.

new.name: Sports & Fitness
new.scope: Sports and their names, equipment, playing actions, competition and results, teams and officials, the gym, training and fitness. Injury belongs to salud; keep to the sporting side.

new.name: Music, Film & Art
new.scope: Music (instruments, performance, genre), film and theatre (roles, production, watching), visual art (media, technique, galleries). Roughly a third each.

new.name: Government, Law & News
new.scope: Government and elections, law and the courts, rights and citizenship, the press and reporting. Basics is capped at 30: genuinely basic civic vocabulary runs out well before 50.

new.name: Safety & Trouble
new.scope: Crime and policing, theft, risk and danger, accidents and fire, security and precaution, warnings and reporting trouble. Medical emergency belongs to salud — keep to the safety side.
